about: Everything D-H repairs. A self-loop hierarchy edge on r (never a parent, never a note). m has two parents whose dense order and edge order disagree: a (dense 1, edge 3) and b (dense 2, edge 1); the lowest edge index wins, so b is kept and edge 3 is note (2, 3). r parents a twice (edges 2 and 4): the repeat is note (2, 4). Two parent cycles: x > y > z > x (its last edge a child_of) broken at x, the lowest dense index, dropping edge 7, note (1, 7); c > d > c (a child_of and a parent_of) with a tail c > t, broken at c, dropping edge 8, note (1, 8). z parents b, so m hangs off the broken cycle. One relates_to edge. Roots r, x, c: a virtual root.
